import type { HTMLAttributes } from "react";

export function Bubble({ className = "", side = "incoming", ...props }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { side?: "incoming" | "outgoing" }) { return <div className={`co-max-w-[80%] co-rounded-xl co-px-4 co-py-3 co-text-sm ${side === "outgoing" ? "co-ms-auto co-bg-black co-text-white" : "co-bg-black/5 co-text-black"} ${className}`.trim()} {...props} />; }
